description: This file defines the EmailAddress class, which extends the SugarEmailAddress class. It acts as a stub to allow other classes, such as Link, to easily use the SugarEmailAddress class. The class provides a constructor and an overridden save method, adding some default properties related to email security and opt-out preferences.

classes.name: EmailAddress
classes.description: A stub class extending SugarEmailAddress, providing a constructor and save method, and designed to facilitate link-based access to email address functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmailAddress object, sets disable_row_level_security to true, and initializes opt_out and invalid_email properties.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the email address data. If multiple arguments are provided, it delegates to parent::saveEmail; otherwise, it calls SugarBean::save.
